pr_body:
When validating cluster restores, we no longer want to ensure that the `version` key in the `system.tenant_settings` table is restored. As of the changes in #125881, that row is no longer restored.

Fixes: #126619

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/126737)
